description: Earth worlds only: keeps 14 flagship LoP dinosaur families (incl. 15 lopgapfill genera) in their real fossil home regions by vetoing natural spawns outside them (per species variant, generous subcontinent boxes). Inert in any world whose config does not set earthWorldgen=true. Never affects tamed, bred, placed or already-loaded animals: the veto sits on the game's natural-spawn attempt event, which those paths never use. Config: ModConfig/earthflagships.json (master switch + one switch per family, all default on). STAGED BUILD for review; see earth-realms/REPORT.md.
name: Earth Flagships
